'''House Algoran''' is one of the known [[Nobility|noble]] [[House]]s of [[Amadicia]].

The only known member of the House is Lady [[Marande Algoran]]. She is the sister of the [[High Seat]] of the House, and is appointed as a lady-in-waiting to [[Queen of Andor|Queen]] [[Morgase Trakand]] of [[Andor]] during her exile in Amadicia. She acts rather cruelly to her mistress, taunting her about her loss of the [[Lion Throne]].
